## Summary

Which documents or files does this pull request add or change?

## Checklist

- [ ] The source of each fact is recorded (office, person or URL), with the date and my GitHub handle.
- [ ] Anything said verbally has been confirmed in writing (`confirmed_in_writing: true`).
- [ ] Where the website and an office disagree, the office or official document is used and `conflict_note` explains the difference.
- [ ] No personal phone numbers, private emails or secrets. Only official office contacts appear.
- [ ] Images and original files are in Cloudinary through `ictkb intake`, not committed.
- [ ] Every attachment has a human-written description.
- [ ] No `[[TO FILL]]` placeholder remains in documents set to `status: verified`.
- [ ] `ictkb validate` passes locally.
